newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks resume rise after Thanksgiving.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks resume rise after Thanksgiving.

text.p: Stocks ended little changed Monday after a session marked by early profit-taking and late buy programs.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended even with Friday's close of 6,521.70, after falling almost 49 points earlier in the session. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a narrow margin on active volume of 415 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
